articleTitle: Research on Multiple Classification Detection for Network Traffic Anomaly Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to ensure network security, a multiple classification detection model based on DeepFM framework is constructed to improve the accuracy of network traffic anomaly detection. Firstly, the FM module was adopted to make the model self-build cross features, and the A-ResNext model was introduced into the DNN module to perform group convolution operation on features. Then, it is integrated with self-attention mechanism to reduce redundant features. Finally, the network classifier is used to realize the multiple classification detection of traffic anomalies. Experimental results showed that the accuracy and F1 value of the proposed multiple classification model in malicious traffic detection task are 82.18% and 78.95%, respectively, which are higher than those of the traditional classification detection model. It can be seen that the proposed model is feasible and effective to accurately detect the abnormal state of network traffic.

articleTitle: GPR-Bi-LSTM power battery health state estimation and remaining life prediction based on ICEEMDAN algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper presents a unique method for estimating the state of health and remaining life of Li-ion batteries by fusing Gaussian process regression and neural networks. Specifically, the original capacity data are decomposed using the advanced empirical mode decomposition method to obtain several intrinsic mode components and a residual, representing local capacity regeneration and global degradation, respectively. Global degradation is tracked using a bidirectional long-short-term memory neural network, and the regenerative component is captured using Gaussian process regression. Considering the sensitivity of Bi-LSTM to parameters, the particle swarm algorithm with random weight is used for parameter optimization. Results on the NASA battery dataset show that the proposed method does not exceed 1% error in early SOH and RUL predictions.

articleTitle: Convolution neural network with multiple pooling strategies for speech emotion recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Speech emotion recognition (ASC) is an important part of speech recognition. The convolutional neural network (CNN) has shown excellent performance in ASC. However, the Traditional CNN models usually use the last fully connected layer as the output of the model. Lack of time- frequency related information research results in an inadequate depth of emotional information mining. Moreover, CNN only focuses on the convolution region in each convolution and cannot focus on the global features. To better explore the recognition effect of speech features in CNN, a CNN model with multiple pooling strategies is proposed. Mel-spectrum is the input to the model. CNN learns emotional details. In addition, three global average pooling layers (GAP) connect different pooling layers to reduce the dimensions of different tensors. Then, an Average Pyramid Pooling (APP) layer is used to fuse all features. Finally, a SoftMax classifier is used to classify different emotions. Experiments prove that the improved CNN model has a better recognition effect than the traditional model.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Modeling Based on 3D Laser Scanning Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to further improve the anomaly detection level of transmission lines, a transmission line three-dimensional modeling method based on 3D laser scanning point cloud data was proposed. The AP clustering algorithm based on density features was used to segment and extract power lines, so as to obtain high-precision power line point cloud data. Then, the 3D model was transformed into a 2D plane model. Finally, the above modeling method was applied to the tree barrier detection of 2D kd-tree. The results showed that AP clustering based on density feature shows good clustering effect when segmenting and extracting power lines. Compared with other clustering algorithms, the proposed clustering algorithm shows good clustering effect in terms of classification rate, adjusted Rand index, silhouette coefficient and running time, and the accuracy reaches 99.5678%. Combined with the application of tree barrier detection of kd-tree, the proposed modeling method has higher detection accuracy and efficiency in tree barrier detection, and it only takes 7.68s to complete the detection. Therefore, the proposed modeling method shows good performance and application effect, which provides a new reference for the application of 3D modeling technology in power engineering.

articleTitle: Multi-condition Fault Diagnosis of Internal Combustion Engine Based on Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to further improve the accuracy of intelligent diagnosis of internal combustion engine, a fault diagnosis method based on improved deep belief network was proposed. Where, the deep belief network (DBN) was improved by using fast Fourier transform (FFT). The simulation results showed that the fault diagnosis model based on FFT-DBN can accurately recognize the fault, and the classification recognition accuracy reaches 99.99%. Compared with other diagnostic models, the classification recognition accuracy of the fault diagnosis model used in this paper is significantly higher. The above simulation results verify the superiority of the design and the effectiveness of the optimization, which has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Construction of rail wear and crack initiation prediction model combined with BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the prediction of rail wear and crack initiation, based on the data measurement and analysis of the actual on-site wear and crack initiation of rails. A BP neural network combined with non-equidistant gray prediction model of rail wear and crack initiation is proposed. The prediction model realizes the prediction of rail wear and crack initiation by using the original test data of the rail at unequal time intervals, and takes the detected rail wear and crack initiation data as the model training sample, and then obtains the rail prediction result. After model training, it can be seen that after the BP network optimizes the residual sequence, the rail wear prediction result of the GM-BP model is basically consistent with the actual prediction curve, and the relative error result is 0.091%. Compared with the prediction result of the GM model, the accuracy is improved by 31.6%. In the prediction of rail crack initiation, the GM-BP model also has better prediction accuracy, which satisfies the construction and maintenance requirements of railway rail traffic, and has important reference significance for the development of modern railway traffic.

articleTitle: Combined Image Enhancement for Recyclable Waste Object Detection In Low-Light Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: An improved DETR target detection algorithm is proposed to address the problems of low accuracy and high false detection rate of detecting recyclable garbage by traditional target detection algorithms under low light environment. Firstly, the low illumination dataset is synthesized using gamma transform and Gaussian noise on the homemade recyclable garbage dataset to simulate the low illumination environment. Secondly, the ResNet50 network of the DETR model is replaced by the ResNeXt50 network, which improves the accuracy by a small margin, and the mAP0.5 is improved by 1.6%. Finally, to solve the problem of poor detection effect of the algorithm in low-light environment, the noise removal module and low-light enhancement module are added before the feature extraction network to significantly improve the detection performance of the DETR algorithm in low-light environment. The experimental results show that the average accuracy is improved by 25.5% to 96.4% compared with the conventional DETR model. The performance is also excellent compared with mainstream target detection models. When detecting recyclable garbage in a low-light environment, the algorithm can perform the detection task better and shows comparable detection results to those in normal environments.

articleTitle: Students' classroom Emotion Analysis Based on Intelligent Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to further accurately obtain the classroom learning status of online students, a multimodal emotion recognition method was proposed to improve the accuracy of students' classroom emotion recognition. Convolutional neural network was used as speech recognition and facial expression recognition methods. The decision-level fusion method based on sum rule was used as multimodal information fusion method. The simulation results showed that the average recognition rate of the speech emotion recognition method proposed in this paper increases with the increase of training samples. When the learning rate is 0.001, the average recognition rate of the model is the highest, reaching 80.1%. The facial expression recognition method proposed in this paper is the most accurate for the recognition of approval and distracted expressions. Compared with other models, the multimodal emotion recognition method based on sum rule and decision-level fusion proposed in this paper has the highest recognition rate, reaching 87.99%. The above simulation results verified the superiority of the design of this paper and the necessity of improvement, and had certain practical reference value.

articleTitle: Learning Spatiotemporal Features for Video Semantic Segmentation Using 3D Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In recent years, significant progress has been made in still image segmentation. However, applying these advanced algorithms to each video frame requires extensive calculation. In this paper, we made two main contributions. The first contribution is a new dataset, we made a human semantic segmentation video dataset based on the Refer-YubeVOS dataset. It provides a benchmark for evaluating video semantic segmentation models. The second contribution is to propose a video semantic segmentation architecture suitable for spatiotemporal feature learning and a method for modifying 2D networks into 3D networks. The trials showed that the 3D network outperforms the 2D network on our dataset. And it is concluded that 3D HRNetV2 has the best performance, with an mIoU<inf>v</inf> of 61.72%, 14.89% higher than 2D HRNetV2.

articleTitle: Research on Security Service Model of Software Defined Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To improve the quality of network security service, the physical device service mode in traditional security service is improved, and the NFV network security service system is constructed by combining software defined networking (SDN) and network function virtualization technology (NFV). Where, network service is provided in the form of security service chain, and Web security scan service is taken as the task, finally the implementation and verification of the system are carried out. The test result shows that the security service system based on NFV can balance the load between the security network service devices in the Web security scan, which proves that the network security system based on software defined security and NFV technology can meet certain service requirements, and lays the research foundation for the improvement of the subsequent user network security service.

articleTitle: Design of a multi-channel fatigue test monitoring cloud platform based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The fatigue test, as an essential means widely used in fatigue life detection of machine components, is characterized by a long test cycle, large amounts of data, and many unexpected conditions, which leads to a heavy monitoring work of fatigue test. Given the above problems, this paper proposes a multi-channel fatigue test monitoring system based on IoT (Internet of Things) and cloud services. It develops a monitoring cloud platform based on the Java EE framework, HTTP, and WebSocket communication protocols to realize the management of test data and user equipment information as well as the visual monitoring of fatigue tests. It can also communicate with the system’s test server and Android client. On this basis, the cloud platform is trialed with other layers of hardware and software devices in the system. The test results show that the performance of the monitoring cloud platform is stable and sound, and the expected functional effects are achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Intelligent Control Method Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to improve the local obstacle avoidance ability of intelligent robots, an obstacle avoidance strategy based on deep reinforcement learning is proposed. The double-stream Q network structure is utilized to train and process the laser ranging data, and the motion data of moving obstacles is used as the observation input, which solves the problem of robot local obstacle avoidance effect in complex, dynamic and unknown environment. Simulation results show that after 1000 simulated obstacle avoidance scenarios, the average reward value of double-stream Q network structure is 780.5, and its average number of moving steps is 809.4. Compared with the other two basic deep reinforcement networks, its learning speed is faster, reward value is higher, and effect difference is more obvious, which indicates that it is more superior in solving the robot local obstacle avoidance problem.

articleTitle: An Improved Genetic Algorithm for Generation of Pairwise Combination Test Cases
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To solve the problem of redundant test cases in the process of generating test cases for numerical simulation software, we proposed Population Split Genetic Algorithm (PSGA). We adopt the idea of greedy algorithm and population splitting as well as individual exchange to improve generation algorithm. Firstly, We introduce the idea of greedy algorithm to update the fitness in genetic algorithm. Secondly, we add the steps of population splitting and individual exchange between populations on the basis of genetic algorithm. Improved genetic algorithm enhances the global optimization ability and avoids falling into the local optimum dilemma when generating test cases. Finally, we proposed an evaluation method based on the redundancy of covered combination. We compared the test case generation results with PICT, Allpairs and Acts tools. Furthermore, we compared with genetic algorithm and its derivatives. Experimental results show that the PSGA can effectively reduce the number of test cases compared with the above tools and algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on personalized resource recommendation algorithm for parent education
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Because of the single teaching mode, the extreme imbalance of educational resources and the low efficiency of education, the traditional parent education can no longer meet the requirements of educational informationization. Therefore, in order to improve the learning efficiency of learners, the research introduces collaborative filtering algorithm based on the construction of personalized recommendation model, and verifies its effectiveness while improving it. The experimental results show that, compared with Random algorithm, the accuracy of User based Collaborative Filtering (UBCF) algorithm is 65.53%, which is much better than Random algorithm; Among the three different methods, the accuracy of collaborative filtering algorithm is the highest, reaching 67.92%, and the performance of this method is the best under the same data. In a word, in parent education, collaborative filtering algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of recommendation results and help parents find deficiencies in the teaching process.

articleTitle: Application of prototypical networks in microbiome-based disease prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Scientific research has revealed that the interaction between the human microbiome is closely related to the human health state. Modeling this relationship using machine learning methods can predict host phenotypes, revealing host-microbe interactions. The prototypical networks are firstly introduced in this paper to predict host phenotype employing species abundance of microbial taxa. Meanwhile, a novel loss function is utilized to optimize the basic prototypical networks, aiming to reduce the distance between homogeneous samples, increase the distance between heterogeneous samples, and then stretch the class. Experiments show that our method is robust and competitive with existing state-of-the-art methods in terms of phenotype prediction accuracy on real metagenomic data.

articleTitle: Security protection strategy of power terminal based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of security vulnerabilities in embedded power terminals, this paper studies the application of long short-term memory neural network to the security protection of power terminals, and establishes a security protection model. According to the characteristic that the protection model lacks negative samples for training in the training process, the study uses the characteristics of long short-term memory neural network to improve the model, and compares and analyzes it with the same type of model in practical applications. The results show that the model designed by the research has a model accuracy of 0.99 in the original dataset and a model accuracy of 0.98 in the mixed dataset, and the model performance data is the best among the same type of models. It can be seen that the model of research design has sufficient practicability and can provide a new idea for related fields.

articleTitle: State-of-Health Prediction of lithium-Ion Battery Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Since the sample data will affect the accuracy of the prediction of the state of health (SOH) of Li-ion batteries based on machine learning, we propose a Transfer learning (TL) method based on Two-stage TrAdaBoost.R2 in this paper. Firstly, the root-mean-square (RMSE) of the source and target domains of the training set is obtained by using support vector regression (SVR), and the parameter α is introduced to adjust the initial weights of these two, and secondly, the similarity between the source domain and the target domain is measured by using the multiple kernel-maximum mean discrepancy (MKMMD), and the weights of the target domain of the training set are updated on this basis. Finally, the proposed algorithm, the original algorithm and the classical machine learning algorithm are compared, and the experimental results show that the RMSE of the proposed method can be less than 0.8% under the condition of insufficient sample data.

articleTitle: Construction of Early Warning Model of Geological Disasters Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In view of the problem that traditional geological disaster monitoring methods cannot adapt to the development of big data, an early warning model of geological disasters based on data mining was proposed. Firstly, the function of the early warning system was determined, and the system included login, data mining and cleaning, early warning and other functions. Secondly, the early warning evaluation system of geological disasters was constructed from the three aspects of susceptibility, hazard and risk, and then the risk was early warned and evaluated by analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy evaluation method. The experimental results showed that in the actual prediction, the early warning results obtained by the early warning model of geological disasters based on data mining are consistent with the actual situation. Moreover, compared with the historical data, the prediction accuracy of the medium above disaster data in the early warning model reaches 87.433%. Therefore, the early warning model of geological disasters based on data mining can accurately predict geological disasters.

articleTitle: Research on Education Cost Prediction Based on Improved BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to better predict the education cost and improve the utilization rate of university funds, an education cost prediction model based on K-means clustering improved PSO-BP neural network was proposed. Firstly, aiming at the problem that BP neural network is prone to trap into local optimization and its convergence speed is slow, PSO was proposed to optimize the parameters of BP. Considering the limitations of PSO, the K-means clustering algorithm was added to cluster particle swarms, thereby enriching the diversity of the population. Finally, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm was used for the education cost prediction of BP neural network. The results showed that the optimization performance of the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is more stable and the convergence speed is faster. At the same time, in terms of prediction accuracy, the education cost prediction accuracy of the improved PSO-BP is higher.

articleTitle: An Intrusion Detection Approach Based on Improved Deep Belief Network and LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: With the development of network technology, network attacks and intrusion methods have become more and more complex and diverse. Aiming to solve the problems of low classification accuracy and high false-positive rate (FPR) in existing intrusion detection methods, this paper proposes an intrusion detection approach based on improved Deep Belief Network (DBN) and Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM). Then, non-linear feature extraction based on the improved DBN is performed, and the new dataset obtained is given as input to a LightGBM for classification. Finally, experimental results performed on the dataset present accuracy of 97.73% and an FPR of 1.32%. The results show that the proposed approach has great improvement in classification accuracy and FPR.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Medical Guidance Information System Based on Factor Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The limitation of traditional hospital management and medical guidance mode is not conducive to the intelligent development of hospitals, while the rapid development of computer and communication technology has put forward higher requirements for hospitals and even the entire medical industry, which needs to provide more perfect information services. This paper aims to study the design and application of the hospital recognition information system based on factor cluster analysis. By analyzing the indoor navigation technology, the method of factor cluster analysis and the system performance requirements, the hospital recognition information system is designed, and the performance of the system is tested. The test results show that there are no obvious major loopholes in the system implementation results at present, and the passing rate of software test cases also meets the on-line requirements of the system, which is feasible. This study can provide theoretical support and optimization reference for the design and application of hospital navigation system.

articleTitle: Research on Green Driving Algorithm of Electric Power Enterprises based on Driving Behavior
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high energy consumption in the driving behavior of electric power enterprises, a driving style modeling method based on generative adversarial network was proposed. The generative adversarial network could quantify the driving styles, and then the energy-saving characteristics of driving styles were modeled according to the driving curve of energy-saving driving style. Experimental results indicated that after 10 non-energy-saving vehicle speed curves are trained by the driving style model based on generative adversarial network, vehicle energy consumption can be reduced by 4 to 5 degrees per 100 kilometers, which means that the driving style model based on generative adversarial network can realize the transfer of energy-saving characteristics of driving style, so as to reduce the vehicle energy consumption. Therefore, the driving style model based on generative adversarial network can effectively solve the problem of high energy consumption in the driving behavior of electric power enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Recognition Algorithm of Industrial Instrument Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy of image classification and positioning recognition of industrial instruments, an instrument reading recognition algorithm based on bilinear difference improved Mask-RCNN was proposed by taking pointer instrument as the research object. Firstly, the algorithm adopted Mask-RCNN instance segmentation network to distinguish the pointer region and the dashboard region. Then, the position and direction of the instrument panel were corrected by the perspective transformation algorithm based on irregular ellipse. Finally, the principal component analysis (PCA) algorithm was used to fit the pointer line, and the angle method was utilized to recognize the pointer reading. The results showed that compared with the Mask-RCNN algorithm before improvement, the target positioning accuracy and instance segmentation accuracy of the improved Mask-RCNN algorithm are improved by about 3% and 2%, respectively. The average relative error and average quoted error between the proposed algorithm and manual reading values are 1.14% and 0.253%, respectively, and the instrument recognition error is small, which indicated that the proposed method can effectively improve the accuracy of instrument image classification and positioning, and can be widely applied in the field of industrial instruments.

articleTitle: GAME-BC: A Graph Attention Model for Exploring Bitcoin Crime
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Blockchain technology has been invented as a fundamental technique to the cryptocurrency Bitcoin in 2008, which is decentralized, consensus and cryptographic leger. However, due to the anonymity of the Blockchain, Bitcoin has been becoming one critical finance platform applied to transfer or hidden criminal income by offenders. Bitcoin crime refers to criminal activities which use Bitcoin as a criminal tools, criminal object or criminal settlement. Typical bitcoin crimes include online gambling, money laundering, fraud and more. To address these issues, our work aims to propose an efficient method to find transactions related with Bitcoin crime in the Bitcoin network. Which will efficiently support regulators to combat Bitcoin crimes. Through collecting and concluding kinds of Bitcoin crimes, we find several typical relation patterns among Bitcoin transactions with respect to crimes, and then construct and analysis a bitcoin criminal transaction network. At last, we study a graph neural network model with attention mechanisms to detect illegal transactions. Experimental results show that our method can achieve better classification accuracy, and has the ability to efficiently detect criminal clues and locate related illegal transactions.

articleTitle: Fault Monitoring of Flexible Switching Distribution Network on Account of Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: At present, there are many problems in distribution network monitoring, such as few detection methods and less system usage. To solve these problems, a fault monitoring method based on genetic algorithm is proposed. The configuration and database of distribution network fault detection system are carefully investigated, the distribution network fault occurrence data in recent ten years are captured, the power load status of distribution network is identified by genetic algorithm, and the power is predicted. The parameters of membership degree and power factor mismatch degree are introduced to judge the fault of power distribution network. This paper studies the fault monitoring of flexible switching distribution network based on genetic algorithm, and discusses the application of the fault monitoring of flexible switching distribution network based on genetic algorithm. The test results show that the fault monitoring of flexible switching distribution network based on genetic algorithm is more efficient and safer than other network fault monitoring.

articleTitle: Big Data Storage Index Mechanism Based on Hierarchical Indexing and Concurrent Updating
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In modern war, it is of great practical significance for the military powers to improve the command efficiency of commanders on the battlefield, it is necessary to use real-time, efficient, and reliable big data storage index method. The application of Hibase-based hierarchical index technology and hot data cache replacement technology can effectively improve the query and storage efficiency of big data, and solve the shortcoming of non-primary key data requiring full table scan. ZooKeeper distributed read-write lock can effectively solve the problem of data consistency caused by frequent concurrent updating of big data information. Finally, the experiment proves that Hive’s query efficiency is improved by nearly 12%.

articleTitle: Research on Delivery Mode of Fresh E-commerce Under Uncertain Delivery-pickup Time
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of fresh products, high loss of products and low income have become pain spot in the fresh e-commerce market. Starting from the loss caused by the perishability of fresh e-commerce products, this paper establishes a cross-delivery model of fresh products to solve the above problems. In this post customers and order demand are generated by random simulation under the condition of uncertainty of delivery and pickup time. After that the overall cargo damage and customer satisfaction indicators are calculated by using the customer-order matching serial number. At the end distribution stage, there are two delivery modes named as first-come-first-delivery and n-person group delivery that can be developed in the future. And the optimal delivery mode first-come-first-delivery is obtained through the verification, comparison and analysis of numerical examples. In this mode, the loss rate of products with Weibull distribution and linear distribution of deterioration rate can be reduced by 7.26% and 5.92% compared with the original mode, and the average customer satisfaction rate is increased by 10.59%. This paper discusses the end distribution optimization method of fresh e-commerce, which provides reference value for future research.

articleTitle: Study on flight test of Terrain awareness and warning system
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The flight test of terrain awareness and warning system is a risky flight test subject. This system is usually consisted of eight sub-modes, including the basic mode from mode 1 to mode 6 and two enhanced modes. In the flight test of TAWS, high requirements are put forward for terrain selection, flight test technology, flight test planning and risk control. The key point of TAWS flight test is to find suitable terrain and prevent from control flight into terrain and the knock it off condition during the flight test. This paper expounds the technology and risk of TAWS flight test in details.

articleTitle: Synergistic Effect Research of K-modes Algorithm in the Evaluation of Physical Education Teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of evaluation of physical education teaching, a physical education teaching evaluation method based on improved K-modes was proposed. Firstly, the minimum sum of the squared errors method and similarity calculation method were used to improve the number of cluster families, the initial cluster center and the distance measure method, so as to improve the traditional K-modes clustering. Then, the ratio of intra-class average distance and inter-class average distance was used as the evaluation index to evaluate the proposed algorithm. The results showed that compared with other algorithms, the proposed improved K-modes algorithm can best cluster teachers into three categories. In the actual evaluation test, the ratio of K-modes improved algorithm is 0.2302, the ratio of "random+0-1 matching method" and "SSE+ similarity calculation method" is 0.7241 and 0.3497, respectively. It shows that the improved K-modes algorithm has better clustering effect and more effective effect on physical education teaching evaluation.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Software Defined Network Security Service Choreography System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: According to different users’ personalized network security service requirements, a software defined network security service choreography system has been constructed. The system is composed of service choreography layer, service management layer and service data layer. The architecture and technical details of the system are introduced in detail. Taking single domain as the construction object, this paper explains that the most basic intra-domain choreography structure of the system consists of service controller, network controller and classifier. Expanding from single domain to multi-domain network environment, this paper adds distributed database. Moreover, a path choreography algorithm for multiple network security service controllers is proposed. The experimental results show that the proposed software- defined network security service choreography system can effectively protect the network in the multiple data center environment, which shows that the system is feasible in practical application.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Risk Prediction Method of Listed Companies Based on GA-RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Research on the problem shows that it is difficult to form a normalized risk forecast for listed companies, which makes it difficult for company management to keep up with risk changes. The radial basis neural network model is used to construct listed companies' financial risk prediction models. At the same time, according to the shortcomings of the difficulty in determining the parameters of the radial basis neural network model, the genetic algorithm is used to improve it, and the parameter determination steps are optimized to enhance the overall performance of the model. The results of the study show that the prediction error of the GA-RBF (Genetic Algorithm-radial basis function) neural network model designed in the study has increased overall, and finally dropped to 10-2. At the same time, only one sample of the intercepted prediction samples is in the abnormal state of prediction, and the prediction effect is significantly stronger than in Traditional forecasting models. It can be seen that the GA-RBF neural network model designed by the research can achieve more accurate and stable forecasting effects in practical applications and lay the foundation for the normalized forecasting of listed companies.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Usage of University History Image Data Database Based on Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to further strengthen the storage and sharing level of school history image data, a massive data sharing method based on cloud storage was proposed. In order to improve the utilization efficiency of cloud storage space, the optimization algorithm based on the residual space was used to optimize the cloud storage space, and the intermediate value fitting effect optimal heuristic algorithm was used to solve the virtual machine placement problem in the cloud storage process of school history image data. Experimental results showed that compared with the Cinder algorithm, the optimization algorithm based on residual space used in this paper has higher computational efficiency on the second dataset of the school history image database, which is improved by 35%. Compared with MBFD algorithm and PABFG algorithm, the intermediate value fitting effect optimal heuristic algorithm consumes less power. It is concluded that the spatial optimization algorithm and the virtual machine placement algorithm can further improve the storage and sharing level of the school history image data database.

articleTitle: MFSCD* Lite: A situation-based path planning algorithm for agent in wargame
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Path planning plays a vitally important role for agents in adversarial strategy games, and even directly determines the final success or failure at times. However, most previous studies of path planning focus on minimizing path length or cost, ignoring the growing complexity resulting from dynamic changing situations. In this paper, we propose a multi-factor situational coupling D* lite (MFSCD* lite) to address the issues above. First, this paper models important dynamic situational factors and integrates them into MFSCD* lite, allowing the planning path to dynamically fit with the changing of situation. Secondly, the buffer and extended buffer of factor-values are established to reduce the repeated calculation of situational factors in MFSCD* lite. And the update strategy is optimized to improve the efficiency of path planning. To validate the effectiveness of our method, we conduct comprehensive experiments on wargame, a typical real-time agent adversarial game. The experimental results show that MFSCD* lite can meet the needs of high-quality and fast path planning, which is better than ordinary path planning algorithms. Further, it has achieved excellent performance in major wargame competitions.

articleTitle: Solving VRPTW Problem Based on Improved Drosophila Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the defects of premature convergence, local poor investigation ability and difficulty in obtaining the best path in traditional swarm intelligent transportation algorithm, an improved Drosophila Optimization algorithm is proposed. In this method, the optimization goal is to minimize the minimum delivery distance. A Drosophila optimization algorithm based on step exponential reduction strategy and distribution perturbation strategy can minimize the distribution distance and optimize the target. In the mutation process, the reverse selection mechanism of the roulette wheel is used, and the optimal value after perturbation is selected as the basis for step size change, so as to maintain the diversity of the fruit fly population, so that the algorithm maintains a good optimization ability and further enhances the search ability. Finally, the simulation experiment on Matlab shows that the algorithm can not only improve the overall optimization effect, but also has strong stability and is not easy to be disturbed. It can provide a new method to solve the VRPTW problem.

articleTitle: Platoon longitudinal and lateral control and cooperative positioning algorithm based on DMPC and FedKF
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Platoon control helps to improve road utilization and reduce congestion under existing road conditions, but GPS signal error often affects the stability of platoon system. To solve this problem, this paper considers the longitudinal and lateral control and cooperative positioning of the platoon, establishes the dynamic model of the platoon composed of five vehicles, designs distributed model prediction controllers for the platoon, and uses the Federated Kalman Filter (FedKF) method to realize the fusion of GPS signals and radar signals in the platoon, so as to make sufficient use of the information redundancy of the platoon to improve the positioning accuracy, reduce speed fluctuation and improve system stability. Finally, the simulation experiment compares the platoon based on Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) and the platoon based on FedKF. It is confirmed that the designed controller has a good effect on the platoon control and the platoon using FedKF has more advantages in positioning accuracy and other aspects in the presence of GPS positioning errors, radar detection errors and dynamic process noises.

articleTitle: HDR image identification network based on edge difference
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Due to its ability to represent a greater range of colors than conventional low dynamic range (LDR) imaging, high dynamic range (HDR) imaging has been widely applied in the multimedia community. However, to our best knowledge, forensic studies tailored for the authenticity recognition of HDR images are lacking. This paper proposes a network called SAA-Net, which aims to differentiate HDR images from LDR ones based on a spatial rich model (SRM) edge enhancement block and the dual attention mechanism. First, we leverage the edge enhancement block to enhance the subtle jitter characteristics of HDR images. Next, with the double attention mechanism, the network is guided to pay attention to the abnormal information and location information of the strong contrast edge of the image. The proposed network shows superior performance over the state-of-the-art in identifying both real HDR images and synthetic HDR ones.

articleTitle: UNEG: A Description-Enhanced Graph-based News Recommendation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Modeling news and users accurately became more and more crucial in personalized news recommendation. Exploring rich relational information with graph-based representation learning methods is challenging. Existing graph-based methods learn the representations of news items and user interests with external knowledge graphs or user-news bipartite graphs. However, they rarely link two news through the entities they refer to in common and fail to consider their correlations. In this paper, we propose a novel User-News-Entity Graph, named UNEG, which associates news items with their mentioned entities and users with the news articles they browsed. In our practice, we use category-aware graph attention networks to model representations of high-order relationships between nodes in UNEG. Furthermore, we introduce entity descriptions as auxiliary information to enrich the initial representations of entity nodes, which provide additional text information on entity labels. We conduct experiments on a real-world dataset, and the results validate the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Construction of a hybrid education system based on global optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The growing number of students makes colleges and universities pay more and more attention to the construction of online and offline hybrid education systems. In order to improve the processing capability of the hybrid education system, a education system design strategy based on a global optimization algorithm is proposed. In the selection of the global optimization algorithm, the SAA is used as the basis, and the GA is used to improve it. The performance test of the improved SAA shows that the algorithm converges fast and the calculation error is within 0.2. The application of the education system shows that the education system designed by the research has high management ability on the basis of basic teaching functions. The above results show that the global optimization algorithm can effectively improve the teaching ability of the blended education system, and then improve the teaching level.

articleTitle: An Adaptive GViT for Gas Mixture Identification and Concentration Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Estimating the composition and concentration of ambient gases is crucial for industrial gas safety. Even though other researchers have proposed some gas identification and concentration estimation algorithms, these algorithms still suffer from severe flaws, particularly in fulfilling industry demands. One example is that the lengths of data collected in an industrial setting tend to vary. The conventional algorithm, yet, cannot be used to analyze the variant-length data effectively. Trimming the data will preserve only steady-state values, inevitably leading to the loss of vital information. The gas identification and concentration estimation model called GCN-ViT (GViT) is proposed in this paper; we view the sensor data to be a one-way chain that has only been downscaled to retain the majority of the original information. The GViT model can directly utilize sensor arrays’ variable-length real-time signal data as input. We validated the above model on a dataset of 12-hour uninterrupted monitoring of two randomly varying gas mixtures, CO-ethylene and methane-ethylene. The accuracy of gas identification can reach 97.61%, R<sup>2</sup> of the pure gas concentration estimation is above 99.5% on average, and R<sup>2</sup> of the mixed gas concentration estimation is above 95% on average.

articleTitle: A Study on Multi-pose Face Recognition Based on Improved Local Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In view of the problem of attitude change affects face recognition rate, a modified local convolutional neural network is proposed. Firstly, a new convolutional network based on Resnet50 is built to maximize the extraction of image features, and then the data transmission rate is used to reduce, and the number of sampling points to prevent the distortion caused by aliasing. Finally, the method of mapping posture correction is used to obtain the local texture information of the positive face picture obtained in the top-level reconstruction. The experimental results show that the algorithm has significantly improved the recognition accuracy by 1.13% on the face data set LFW compared with the improvement, which makes the face frontal recognition more flexible and accurate.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Demand Prediction Model for Talent Training in Colleges Universities under Division of Labor in the Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to further grasp the training and demand changes of professional and technical talents under the division of labor in the value chain, a demand prediction model for university talent training based on GA-BP has been proposed. First, GA was used to optimize the BP neural network, and then the optimized BP neural network model was used to predict the demand for professional and technical talents in the region. The results showed that compared with the BP neural network model before improvement, GA-BP neural network had smaller prediction error and better prediction performance. The BP neural network prediction model optimized by GA could accurately simulate and predict the demand for professional and technical talents. Based on the traditional BP prediction model, the prediction performance of the model was greatly improved, thus better realizing the accurate control of demand for talent training in colleges and universities under the division of labor in the value chain, and providing a reference for the talent training planning in colleges and universities in China.

Author Keywords: Keywords-the division of labor in the value chain

articleTitle: Internet of Things Terminal Access Security Based on Zero Trust
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: At present, production and daily life increasingly rely on the Internet of Things, and the network security problem of the Internet of Things is becoming increasingly prominent. Therefore, it is extremely important to ensure the network security of the Internet of Things through various technical means. The security of IoT terminal access behavior is an important part of IoT network security, so it is an important research object in the field of network security. In order to increase the security of IoT terminal access, a security evaluation model based on zero trust is proposed. After the simulation performance test of the model, it is found that the model shows excellent detection ability of malicious access behavior and system stability in different network environments. Under the premise that some network nodes are infected, the model proposed in the study still shows a significantly higher ratio of trusted nodes than other algorithms, The research results show that the model can improve the security level of the Internet of Things network to a certain extent.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Vehicle Indoor Positioning Algorithm Based on Multi-Camera Perception
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In warehouses, it is very important to obtain positions of vehicles. However, existing algorithms usually use a single camera to detect positions of vehicles, which has many limitations. First, if some degree of occlusion occurs to the target vehicle, it might not be detected. Second, a single camera’s view is limited. Therefore, we propose a real-time vehicle indoor positioning algorithm based on multi-camera perception. Our work is as follows: 1) Compare performance differences of various types of object tracking algorithms and make a tradeoff between speed and precision to find a tracking algorithm that is real-time and precise. Then combine the tracking algorithm with vehicle detection. 2) Collaborate between multiple cameras, including multi-camera positioning and cross-camera tracking. 3) Use self-built multi-camera vehicle indoor positioning system for test and analysis. Experimental results show that our algorithm has good performance.

articleTitle: Identity Identification of Power Intelligent Terminals Based on Behavior Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to ensure the security of power intelligent terminals, an identity identification method based on behavior feature modeling was proposed. Firstly, user behavior data was collected. Then the user behavior was modeled according to the collected data. Finally, XGBoost regression model was used to identify and classify the user identity. The results showed that the identification accuracy, recall rate and F1 value of user identity identification through behavior modeling and XGBoost regression reach more than 90%, which has a good identification effect; Compared with SVM algorithm and random forest algorithm, the XGBoost regression has better identification effect, and its identification accuracy is 93.09%. Therefore, the proposed identity identification method based on behavior modeling and XGBoost regression can more accurately identify the user identity, so as to improve the security of using terminal.

articleTitle: Summary Model based on Semantic Similarity Attention Focus
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: For the current summary model, it is difficult to obtain context information related to the semantics of the original text, which leads to the problem of inaccurate summary generation. This paper proposes a summary model based on semantic similar attention mechanism. First, a semantic similarity attention mechanism is established. By calculating the cosine distance between the encoder and decoder hidden layer states, and introducing the distance into the attention mechanism to assist the mechanism to obtain context semantics with high semantic similarity to the original text information. Secondly, a fusion loss method for learning semantic similarity features is proposed, and the weighted fusion of the cosine distance and the original loss function is fed back to the semantic similarity attention mechanism, and then the context information is updated iteratively. Finally, the decoder uses the semantic information closest to the original text to generate a more accurate summary. From the experimental results, the model has some advantages over the previous model.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Comparative Analysis Method of Lift Coefficient for Artificial Ice Flight Test
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Although the artificial ice flight test is a pre-flight test for the natural icing flight test, it is still a high-risk flight test. In order to reduce the risk of flight test, this paper proposes a method to compare and analyze the actual lift coefficient and design lift coefficient of the test aircraft in real time according to the current flight state of the test aircraft. This method takes the telemetry data of the test aircraft as the input, and uses the filtering and noise reduction algorithm to improve the data quality. According to the test data such as overload, the actual lift coefficient of the test aircraft can be calculated, while the design lift coefficient can be calculated according to the flight state and the deflection angle of control surfaces. By comparing the two in real time, it is possible to analyze whether the state of the test aircraft deviates from the design value in real time, and provide a reference for the real-time flight test safety assessment.

articleTitle: A Real time Decision Making Method of Electronic Warfare Based on the Protection of Key Points
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Electronic warfare decision-making involves many kinds of targets, different performances, complex environments and other issues, which makes it difficult to make real-time decisions adaptively. It is generally used to simulate the equipment of all parties under the scenario settings to realize the simulation of the battlefield environment of electronic warfare. In order to better realize the real-time combat decision-making of electronic warfare, a real-time decision tree scheme of electronic warfare equipment based on protection key points is proposed here. Through the decision tree, the real-time decision-making of enemy targets in the scene is carried out to realize the battle simulation of electronic warfare. The battle command decision-making of electronic warfare is improved according to the scenario of electronic warfare, and better electronic warfare decision-making is obtained in certain special combat scenarios.

articleTitle: Evaluation of University Teaching Quality Based on Hadoop and Deep Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to further improve the evaluation level of university teaching quality, a university teaching quality evaluation method based on Hadoop and deep mining was proposed. SVM was selected as the classification evaluation method for teaching quality. PSO was selected to optimize SVM data classification. At the same time, considering the problems of PSO algorithm, PSO was improved by weight and random parameter optimization. The results showed that the improved PSO-SVM has a good evaluation effect when evaluating the university teaching quality, and performs better in F1, recall and accuracy. Compared with other improved algorithms, the proposed PSO-SVM algorithm has better convergence performance and shorter distributed running time, which verifies the feasibility of the evaluation method selected in this paper and provides a new qualitative analysis method for the objective evaluation of university teaching.

articleTitle: Design of A Programmable PCI-E Encryption System Based on RISC-V
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a PCI-E programmable encryption system architecture based on RISC-V. The architecture consists of a 5-level pipeline-based RISC-V processor core, a programmable encryption engine, and a PCI-E high-speed encryption engine. The host can call the high-speed encryption engine through PCI-E interface to realize high-speed storage encryption. The throughput can reach 18.8Gbps. The high speed encryption engine can be called by the programmable encryption engine to realize fast encryption processing of different algorithms, and the RISC-V kernel can also be called to realize the parsing and encapsulation of different secure communication protocols. The three different processing methods can be arbitrarily combined to meet the flexible and changeable application requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Tourism Resources Management Method Based on Deep Learning and Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of tourism resources management and the accuracy of tourism resources recommendation, a personalized recommendation method for tourism resources based on deep learning and knowledge graph was proposed. Firstly, the feature vectors of attractions were represented based on the Node2Vec method in knowledge graph feature learning. Then, the potential feature vectors of attractions were obtained by using the feature vectors of attractions as the input of the GRU neural network. Considering the user’s long and short term preferences, the attention mechanism was introduced for modeling, and the probability of each attraction in the next visit was predicted, and finally a recommendation list was generated. The experimental results showed that the HR@10 index value of the proposed method is 41.1%, and the MRR@10 index value is 16.5%, which is higher than that of other recommendation methods. At the same time, in the influence of different dimensions on the recommendation results, with the increase of data dimensions, the hit rate of recommendations also increases. When the dimension is 150, the recommendation effect is the best. Among the effects of different recommendation list lengths on recommendation results, the proposed recommendation method is higher than the other recommendation methods. Therefore, the proposed recommendation method can well recommend tourism resources to users, and the recommendation model shows good recommendation performance for multi-dimensional complex data.

articleTitle: Research on Time-Anchored Law Enforcement Video Correlation Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The correlation between law enforcement video and law enforcement task data is an essential step to achieving the goal of archival management of law enforcement video data. By matching law enforcement video with law enforcement task data and realizing the automatic correlation of the two data, law enforcement data’s management and use efficiency can be significantly improved. Although the GPS location-based automatic correlation method is applied in most cases, its performance in the task-intensive scene is unsatisfactory. Therefore, to achieve accurate correlation even in the case of intensive tasks, this paper proposes a novel solution, discusses the details of design ideas and core algorithms, and verifies the solution’s effectiveness through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Power Fault Data Fusion and Diagnosis Model Based on Improved BP Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The power transformer is the core of the whole power grid. By using the power transformer, the voltage value on the transmission line can be converted into electric energy, thus becoming a hub of the power grid. The current Back Propagation (BP) algorithm has a relatively high probability of local optimization problems, resulting in low fault accuracy. Based on this, the research combines the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm with the Particle Filter (PF) algorithm to improve its structure optimization, so as to propose the PFPSO algorithm. Through this algorithm, the BP network algorithm is improved, and the PFPSO-BP algorithm is obtained, At the same time, its effectiveness is verified. The experimental results show that the PFPSO-BP algorithm is higher than the other three algorithms both in training and in actual experiments, and the average accuracy rate is higher than 90%, the highest is 98%, showing a higher accuracy rate of fault identification, which has a stronger practical application significance in the actual power transformer fault identification.

articleTitle: Data Access Control Method of Power Terminal Based on Trust and Reputation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor data confidentiality, complex communication overhead and large amount of computation in traditional power terminal data access control, a data access control method of power terminal based on trust and reputation was proposed. Firstly, a flexible data access control system of power terminal was designed based on cloud computing technology, and key generation, key segmentation, proxy re-encryption and decryption were adopted to obtain the trust level and user reputation of the end users. Then, the data access of power terminal was controlled. Finally, the security analysis and performance analysis of the user’s trust and reputation evaluation results were carried out through the encryption system. Experimental results showed that the proposed method can effectively reduce the communication overhead and computational complexity of data access, improve data confidentiality, and reduce the application cost of power terminal equipment, and has stability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Real-time Estimation of AOS based on Constant Wind Field Assumption
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Generally, the angle of sideslip (AOS) of the aircraft is measured by the AOS sensor during the flight test. A real-time AOS estimation method which uses the parameters from the GPS, inertial system, the angle of attack vane and air data system is presented in this paper. The method mainly uses the coordinate transformation to get the true airspeed vector in the body axis system with a constant wind field assumption, and then to calculate the AOS according to the true airspeed from the air data system. In order to get the wind field information, a zero AOS segment should be added to the flight procedure. The method can be applied in on-board or telemetry flight test monitoring system to replace the AOS sensor, and provide real-time AOS for the flight crew and ground analyst.

articleTitle: Temperature Recognition of Infrared Temperature Map Based on Improved BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low efficiency and low accuracy of manual recognition of infrared temperature map, a temperature recognition method based on improved BP neural network was proposed. Firstly, de-noising, image enhancement processing and image segmentation processing were performed on the temperature image of infrared thermometry map. Secondly, the normalized Zernike invariant moment was used for feature extraction. Furthermore, the corresponding improvement was carried out on the BP neural network. Finally, the improved neural network was used to classify and recognize infrared images. Experimental results showed that using the improved BP neural network algorithm for training, the accuracy and efficiency of the training results are higher. The improved BP algorithm is used for temperature recognition of infrared images, and its accuracy reaches 99%. Therefore, the improved BP algorithm has a higher recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Establishment of Shipping Container Price Prediction Model for International Trade
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to more accurately grasp the fluctuation trend of container transportation freight in international trade, a prediction model of China Containerized Freight Index (CCFI) based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and BP neural network was proposed. Firstly, EMD was selected to decompose and reconstruct the freight index, and then BP neural network was utilized to predict the freight index. The results showed that compared with EMD-ARIMA prediction model, the EMD-BP neural network prediction model has a better fitting effect, and the predicted value coincides with the true value better. Compared with other models such as EMD-ARIMA, the prediction model based on EMD-BP constructed in this paper shows better prediction performance on root mean squared error (RMSE) and other indicators, and the accuracy of the prediction direction reaches 0.8623. By predicting CCFI freight index, the future freight changes of international trade can be better grasped, so as to obtain the superiority of EMD-BP prediction model proposed in this paper, which has certain engineering application value in the field of international trade.

articleTitle: Research on safety detection of power terminal based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent electronic technology, the application of smart grid is gradually widespread. While smart grid brings many conveniences for people to use electricity, we should also guard against potential safety hazards. In the composition of smart grid, power terminal is an important part of its power supply, and also the basis of its power supply security.The safety of electrical connections is an important guarantee for the normal operation of the electrical network and the personal safety of personnel and must be respected. The research uses the excellent image processing ability of the convolutional neural network to complete the selection and design of the convolutional neural network components according to the actual needs and hardware support. Actual safety status is reflected in isolator test results. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the convolutional neural network in the test set reaches 94.63%, which can be applied to the safety detection of power connectors.

articleTitle: Optimization of Material Distribution Route Based on Green Logistics and Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of slow development of electric logistics due to the low efficiency of traditional electric materials distribution, an optimization method of material distribution route based on ant colony algorithm was proposed. First of all, the multi-objective function was constructed based on customer satisfaction and the shortest distribution distance. Then, combined with the disadvantages of the traditional ant colony algorithm, the pheromone, volatile factor and heuristic factor of the ant colony algorithm were improved to solve the multi-objective function. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm was verified by simulation test. Simulation results showed that compared with traditional ant colony algorithm, when the number of terminal distribution points is 20, the shortest distribution distance obtained by the optimized ant colony algorithm is reduced by 1.7%, and the convergence speed of the algorithm is improved by 34.5%. Therefore, the optimized ant colony algorithm is better than the traditional ant colony algorithm, which can improve the distribution efficiency of electric power material.

articleTitle: Fatigue Driving Detection Method Based on Multiple Features
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy of fatigue driving judgment based on single feature, a fatigue driving detection method based on multiple features was proposed. In order to improve the accuracy of fatigue driving judgment, the RetinaFace algorithm was first used to detect the driver’s face, and then the facial feature points were located to complete the estimation of head posture. Then, the end-to-end convolutional neural network model was used to identify the face state of the eyes and mouth. Finally, combined with the threshold of characteristic parameters of eyes, mouth and head, a fatigue driving detection method based on multiple features was proposed. The experimental results showed that the recognition accuracy of the improved convolutional neural network model for eyes and mouth is more than 95%. The judgment accuracy of the fatigue driving detection method based on feature fusion is more than 90%. Therefore, the fatigue driving detection method based on multiple features is feasible in fatigue driving judgment.

articleTitle: Research on Security Risk Detection System of Intelligent Internet of Things Terminal
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the device anomaly problem in the collection of security risk detection system of intelligent Internet of Things (IOT) terminal, taking DTU power terminal equipment as the research object, and combined with the characteristics of side channel attack, a security sensing method of power intelligent Internet of Things terminal based on LSTM was proposed. Where, on the basis of analyzing the principle of side channel attack and combining the characteristics of side channel attack data as time series, the improved LSTM neural network was adopted to detect and monitor security risks. Finally, the above method was applied to the DTU of the IOT device, so as to verify the effectiveness of the system. Experimental results show that compared with the correlation-based regression algorithm Lasso, the proposed method is superior, which can effectively detect and monitor malicious intrusion of power grid terminals. Among them, the false positive rate is less than 2%, and the accuracy rate is more than 90%, which means that the proposed method can guarantee the security of power IOT terminal devices.

articleTitle: Benchmark Research on Computing Performance of Domestic General-purpose Processors
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Computing performance evaluation is one of the important technical means of computer architecture research. Scientific and fair evaluation of computer performance and evaluation of processor performance rely on general benchmark test suites, which play a strong role in promoting the development of general-purpose processors. This paper introduces the development status of classification, characteristics and evaluation of the benchmark assembly, and realizes the comprehensive evaluation of various performances such as integer operation and floating-point operation for domestic processors with different instruction set architecture in China. This paper selects a variety of domestic processors with different architecture and Intel processors to quantify the performance of the experimental results, and master the development level of domestic general-purpose processors, which plays a vital role in the development of my country’s industrial control field. Experiments show that the performance of domestic general-purpose processors for integer computing is much lower than that of Intel processors, and the performance of domestic general-purpose processors for floating-point computing is significantly improved. However, there is still a significant gap between the performance of domestic general-purpose processors and Intel processors.

articleTitle: Optimal Order Acceptance and Scheduling via Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Order acceptance and scheduling (OAS) in a vital problem for the management of production, storage, transportation processes. In an OAS problem, a decision maker should determine whether or not to accept a newly arrived order, and upon an order accomplished, it should further determine which order will be produced subsequently. This paper proposes an MDP for modeling the OAS problem, where a decision is made by jointly considering multiple features including price, quantity and latest delivery date, delayed delivery cost, and others. Furthermore, a deep reinforcement learning algorithm is developed for solving the optimal OAS policy, which outperforms existing schemes in numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Connected Multi-speech Task for Detecting Alzheimer’s Disease Using a Two-Layer Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Research related to automatic detection of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is important in which progression can be prevented or delayed by early diagnosis because it can help simplify the diagnosis method. Since Alzheimer's disease is known to alter the semantics and acoustics of spontaneous speech, linguistic biomarkers offer hope for non-invasive diagnosis of the disease. Nevertheless, most of the earlier studies only used one language task. Consequently, their findings may not generalize to other areas of cognitive ability. In this paper, we propose a two-layer model combining data from three connected speech tasks: picture description (PD), semantic fluency (SF) and sentence repetition (SR). In the first stage, the PD task is initially used to detect dementia. In the second stage, the SF and SR task are used to classify healthy controls (HC) and mild cognitive impairment (MCI). We also compare the performance of the proposed model with a widely used one-layer model using a pre-fusion approach, and this study shows that the proposed model performs better in the AD detection.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Current Continual Learning Algorithms in an Image Classification Context
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence aims to mimic natural intelligent learning by using lifelong machine learning, which allows an AI to train and learn over its lifetime. Various algorithms have been suggested and developed to allow lifelong learning, these algorithms require deeper analysis, to evaluate and highlight performance benefits. In this research, we will study three state-of-the-art algorithms for lifelong learning: Rehearsal, elastic weight consolidation and synaptic intelligence. We do an analysis and evaluation of their performance in a multiple-task experiment, using different amounts of data, and measuring several performance metrics. We found that these algorithms are similar in performance, but some algorithms perform better than others with less data, or show good performance in task one, but not subsequent tasks. These algorithms could be built upon and improved in future research. The evaluation demonstrated in this research is in the image classification context.

articleTitle: MLFT-Net: Point Cloud Completion Using Multi-Level Feature Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In the field of 3D vision, point cloud is widely used. However, point clouds obtained in the real world are often incomplete. The emergence of point cloud completion can solve this problem well. The previous methods usually feed the latent code that came from the encoder to the subsequent generator, which causes the point cloud at each level cannot to capture information at different levels. Besides, it prevents the model from generating the details of the point clouds. Therefore, we not only use the point cloud features at different levels of the point cloud in the following refinement module, but also integrate these features with the context information to complete the geometry of the point cloud.
