We have done a lot of experiments on PCN and ShapeNet benchmark datasets, and the results show that our method is effective.

articleTitle: Quality assessment of cross-topic article features based on improved CTS model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Assessing article quality is an important task in the field of education. To improve the semantic understanding of the assessment model and improve the generalizability of the article quality assessment system at the same time, an improved cross-topic article features quality assessment method based on CTS (Cross-prompt Trait Scorer) is proposed. In the shared low-level layer part, a new depth-separable convolution with residual structure is used to extract more semantic feature information; in the feature enhancement part, multi-headed attention is added to strengthen the effective features and improve the learning ability of lexicality; finally, a Log-Cosh loss function is used to make the model more robust to outliers and improve the model's QWK (Quadratic Weighted Kappa) evaluation metric of the model. The improved method experimented on the ASAP (Automated Student Assessment Prize) dataset, and the average QWK score reached 0.571 under different topics and 0.566 under different features. The experimental results showed that the improved model obtained superior results in the cross-topic article feature quality assessment task compared to the CTS and PAES (Prompt Agnostic Essay Scorer) models.

articleTitle: Accurate Trajectory Extraction of Dynamic Targets for Driving Behaviour Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The performance of autonomous driving algorithm relies heavily on the quality and quantity of diverse motion datasets. However, existing interactive motion datasets are typically constructed from complicated sensors or mobile intelligent vehicles, and post-process with manual annotation, which are costly, inefficient and not easy to expand. And these datasets represent only one specific driving scene. In our work, we propose a nearly automatic and complete framework to accurately extract a large number of trajectories and behavioural data from fixed traffic monitoring cameras, which leverages advanced visual algorithms. Our framework contains an automatic and evolutionary optimization for camera calibration, which can be executed iteratively based on a common prior knowledge set. We also introduce a new method for ground position and orientation calculation. A series of postprocessing processes is added to ensure accuracy and diversity. Finally, the data content is expanded with motion- related features, coarse target information and behaviour related features. The results demonstrate that a large number of motion trajectories can easily be obtained through the proposed framework and that the average precision of the trajectory can reach 36 cm, which is precise enough for actual behavioural analysis.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Making CNN Immune to Backdoor Attack by Activating Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: When a neural network is trained with a data set from an untrusted source, an attacker can insert poisoned data with a backdoor trigger into the data set to make the neural network make wrong decisions. By using Activation Clustering over convolutional neural networks, we propose an improved method for defensing backdoor attacks in the process of data collection and preparation. Experimental results show that this method can reliably protect neural networks from the interference of malicious data during training. The essence of this method is making a neural network to learn the feature of the trigger and classify the toxic data into a separate class. The structure of the existing model is also optimized to make the size of the model lightweight.

articleTitle: FAQ question Answering method based on semantic similarity matching
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Frequently asked questions (FAQ) is a typical limited domain-oriented retrieval question answering system, and semantic similarity matching is the key technology of FAQ question answering. Aiming at the FAQ problems of insufficient deep semantic representation and extraction and synonyms and polysemy, this paper proposes a cascade matching model combining coarse-grained recall and fine-grained sorting. Firstly, an improved Okapi BM25 algorithm based on inverse word frequency is proposed. This paper proposes a new solution to FAQ answer based on the traditional text matching and retrieval pipeline, and gives a new semantic similarity matching model. Additionally, we further analyze the shortcomings of semantic matching and the advantages of data-driven semantic similarity matching model. Finally, the proposed hybrid matching model is evaluated. Experimental results show that the proposed method not only ensures the retrieval speed of question and answer, but improves its performance

articleTitle: Development planning of complex equipment based on cumulative prospect theory
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of complex equipment such as large investment, long development cycle, high-performance requirements, and fragility, the development cost is high. Which complex equipment should be given priority requires careful consideration. Considering the risk preference of decision-makers when making decisions, the cumulative prospect theory (CPT) is introduced into the development planning process of complex equipment, and a complex equipment development planning model based on the CPT is established. The objective probability is replaced by the subjective decision weight, and the cumulative prospect value of the scheme is used as the criterion for sorting schemes. Finally, the feasibility of CPT application in equipment development planning is verified by an illustrative case, and the sensitivity of model parameters has been analysed. The result shows that the proposed methods can well describe the incomplete rational behaviour of the decision-maker.

articleTitle: Efficient Traffic Scheduling Using Genetic Algorithm in Time-Sensitive Networking
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking) is promised to play an important role in industrial automation since more and more industrial environments need the support of time-sensitive networking technology to ensure real-time traffic transmission. In IEEE 802.1Qbv of TSN, the GCL (Gate Control List) calculation problem in TAS (Time Aware Shaper) is very critical. We refer to the time it takes for all real-time traffic to complete a cycle of transmission as Flowspan. The objective of a typical GCL calculation approach is to minimize Flowspan using tabu search. However, this method tends to a local optimal solution when the number of streams increases, resulting in a final solution that differs significantly from the global optimal solution. To address this problem, we proposed GAPER, a novel GCL calculation approach based on genetic algorithm with parent elite reservation in this paper. We conducted extensive experiments on DetNet. The experimental results show that our proposed GAPER has significant performance comparing with tabu search. In particular, when the number of flows reaches 20, the Flowspan derived by GAPER is 36.43% lower than the traditional method.

articleTitle: An evaluation system of informatization level in Jinan suburban counties under the background of smart city construction
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Based on the background of Jinan’s smart city construction, this paper considers the unique scientific and technological strength and culture background of Jinan, and aims at the problem of weak informatization in remote areas, taking Pingyin and Shanghe as examples to establish an indicator system including infrastructure, scientific and technological development, medical care, education and other factors. The effective principal components are extracted by factor analysis, and the influencing factors are explored based on regression. According to the established evaluation system, this paper explores the development law of information level in Jinan city, and carries out in-depth analysis. The work of this paper provides certain theoretical support for the construction of smart cities in suburban counties of Jinan.
